items: Breakout removed. WAGES walks side-on, the camera tracking with him, the BadCode logo painted on his flank, then a fade to black.

replies.at728: Fixed: ONEGATEa left a ghost row at the gate while the field ran (the "teleport"). Re-shot 3 takes with the stall kept standing; ONEGATEe has the whole field leave level and nothing jumps. The other two (c, d) are on the clips page. Picture only, no new words.
replies.at788: Done: a photo finish. The field freezes level on the line, a camera flash and shutter click, a black-and-white judges' print scans across left to right with a timing ruler and a finish line on the hooves, header "PHOTOGRAPH" (the call a UK course makes), then it dissolves into the logo. Sound synthesised, no outside clips. Want a stamp on it like "DEAD HEAT"? Your words. Round 3: replaced by the BadCode clip (see at794).
replies.at794: Changed: the photo finish is gone. Now a simple clip: BadCode in the commentary box lowers his binoculars, turns to camera, the camera eases in on the tweed mask, and the mask dissolves into the BadCode logo. Made 4 takes; OUTc picked, the only one with the brand mask (one red triangle; two takes grew a triangle on each eye). New material: 4 Flow clips. Round 4: replaced by the WAGES breakout into the logo (your chat note: "a cool badcode logo outro to do with horses"). Round 5: the logo is now sprayed on WAGES' flank as he walks (your chat note).
